changelog:
The bar you scroll under is glass, this time for real.

WHAT CHANGED

- The bottom navigation bar now blurs what is behind it. Scroll a list and
  the rows soften as they pass under the bar instead of showing through it
  and competing with the labels.
- This is the feature 0.3.3.9 tried to ship and got wrong. That build
  blurred every screen in the app and was unusable; 0.3.3.10 removed it.
  This one is the corrected version.

WHY IT IS DIFFERENT THIS TIME

- The original blurred everything because it reused one drawing surface
  for both the sharp content and the blurred strip, and a surface can only
  carry one effect. There are two surfaces now.
- It was measured on this phone before shipping, not after: at 120 frames
  per second, dropped frames were 0.8 percent with no blur and 0.7 percent
  with it, which is the same number twice.
- And there is now an automatic check that photographs a whole screen and
  compares it. The old checks only photographed individual pieces, which
  is why nothing caught the first attempt.

UNCHANGED

- The player controls and the screen headers keep their tint and get no
  blur, for the reasons in the previous release.

WHY 0.3.3.11 DOES NOT EXIST

- It was tagged and the build refused it. A check added an hour earlier
  looked for this project's git hooks and did not find them on the build
  machine, because a build machine never installs them. The check was
  wrong, not the app.
- Version numbers here are never reused once tagged, so the corrected
  build is 0.3.3.12. Nothing was published under the old number.
